parsed.scene_description: A modern interior with a central spiral bookshelf unit on a circular platform. Large windows line the back wall, showing bright outdoor light and buildings. A red curved structure is visible on the left. Several people are present: one walking near the center-left, another seated at a table in the background, and two more seated to the right. Chairs surround tables on the floor.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: Cylindrical unit with multiple horizontal shelves holding books, illuminated by integrated lighting. Located centrally on a circular wooden platform.

objects.label: circular platform
objects.observation: Large, round wooden base supporting the spiral bookshelf unit. It sits on the floor with visible legs or supports extending down.

objects.label: red curved structure
objects.observation: Large red architectural element curving from the left foreground into the ceiling area. Appears to be part of a staircase or decorative feature.

objects.label: person walking
objects.observation: Individual in dark clothing walking towards the left side of the frame. Positioned near a table and chairs.

objects.label: person seated (background)
objects.observation: Individual sitting at a table in the middle distance, facing away from the camera. Partially obscured by the bookshelf.

objects.label: person seated (right)
objects.observation: Two individuals sitting together at a table on the right side. One wears white clothing.

objects.label: chairs
objects.observation: Multiple chairs with metal frames and dark seats arranged around tables on the floor. Some are near the bookshelf, others near the seated people.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Floor-to-ceiling glass panels forming the back wall. They show reflections and views of exterior buildings and trees.
